content: Next.js 16 security timeline: CVE-2025-66478 React2Shell (CVSS 10.0 RCE via RSC protocol, upstream CVE-2025-55182) affects 15.x and 16.x App Router, fixed in 16.0.7, no workaround, rotate secrets after patching. July 2026 release fixed 9 CVEs in 16.2.11: CVE-2026-64641 DoS via Server Actions (High), 64642 middleware/proxy bypass with Turbopack+single locale (High), 64645 SSRF via rewrites destination (High), 64649 SSRF in Server Actions on custom servers (High), 64644 image-opt SVG DoS, 64646 unbounded Server Action payload on Edge, 64643 Server Function endpoint ID disclosure, 64648+64647 fetch cache confusion on request bodies. August 2026 fixed two criticals in 16.3.3: AVIF image-opt RCE (CVSS 9.5) and Windows Pages+App Router RCE CVE-2026-75604 (CVSS 9.0) — Vercel-hosted apps were not affected by the August pair. Latest stable 16.3.5.
